description: This file implements an in-memory lease provider for development and testing purposes within the Orleans framework. It includes classes and interfaces for managing leases, simulating lease acquisition, renewal, and release, primarily for local or test environments.

classes.name: InMemoryLeaseProvider
classes.description: Implements ILeaseProvider for in-memory lease management, suitable for development and testing.

classes.name: IDevelopmentLeaseProviderGrain
classes.description: Interface for a grain that manages lease information in memory, with a method to reset leases.

classes.name: DevelopmentLeaseProviderGrain
classes.description: A grain class that stores lease information in memory, allowing lease acquisition, renewal, release, and reset.

classes.name: Lease
classes.description: Internal class representing a lease with an expiration time and a token.

methods.name: InMemoryLeaseProvider
methods.description: Constructor initializing the lease provider with a grain factory.

methods.name: Acquire
methods.description: Attempts to acquire leases for a given category and lease requests.

methods.name: Release
methods.description: Releases acquired leases for a given category.

methods.name: Renew
methods.description: Renews leases for a given category and acquired leases.

methods.name: GetLeaseProviderGrain
methods.description: Static method to get the lease provider grain instance.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets all leases in the grain, simulating loss or rebalancing.

methods.name: Acquire
methods.description: Grain method to acquire a lease for a specific request.

methods.name: Release
methods.description: Grain method to release specified leases.

methods.name: Renew
methods.description: Grain method to renew specified leases.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Grain method to clear all stored leases.

methods.name: Lease
methods.description: Represents a lease with expiration and token, updating token on expiration change.
